fitted_wall.physics: Fitted-wall Navier–Stokes, Re = 50, common three-port conditions and P2/P1 FEM
fitted_wall.archived_fitted_settings: Reused the original and raw Navier–Stokes contours by exact geometry-file SHA-256. New cases use the same fitted mesh constructor, nonlinear continuation, boundary data, power, and residual checks via the archived mesh-audit solver path.

comparison.signed_difference_definition: Stokes-optimized contour minus Navier–Stokes-optimized contour, both evaluated under fitted-wall Navier–Stokes

fitted_wall.uncertainty_definition: Maximum of the latest two paired differences and corresponding sums of absolute individual changes. Both contours must pass the existing mesh screen. A resolved power difference must also exceed the combined raw energy residual. This is a screening estimate.
